## Contract PDF to Structured Data

Upload a contract PDF → OCR extracts text → Code node uses regex to extract:
- Effective/expiry dates
- Parties involved
- Amounts
- Term duration
- Contract type

Structured data saved to Sheets, notification sent via Gmail.

**Setup:**
1. Configure OCR API key
2. Set Google Sheets document
3. Set Gmail credentials
